editorial.blurb: A warmly welcoming Brazilian churrascaria where expertly grilled meats, a vibrant buffet spread, and genuinely kind staff create a homey dining experience that keeps guests coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Go hungry and make room for the rotisserie meats—staff will keep bringing skewered proteins to your table, and don't skip the flan for dessert, which they sometimes offer as a celebratory gift.

topDishes.note: Grilled perfectly; the heart of the buffet experience
